# RemotionVidCreator

RemotionVidCreator is a developer-owned workflow for turning a topic or creative
brief into a customizable explainer video and rendering it locally with Remotion.

## Canonical resources

- Website: https://othmaneblial.github.io/RemotionVidCreator/
- Repository: https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/RemotionVidCreator
- README: https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/RemotionVidCreator#readme
- Releases: https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/RemotionVidCreator/releases

## Capability boundaries

- The browser workspace renders 9:16 video; the CLI also supports 16:9, 1:1, 4:5, and 4:3.
- Rendering, local job state, and MP4 output run on the user's machine.
- Z.ai scripting and Unsplash image search are optional network paths.
- The app creates procedural ambient audio, not narration or text-to-speech.
- The project is not a timeline editor, managed rendering API, or text-to-video foundation model.
- Project code is MIT licensed. Remotion is a separate source-available dependency with its own terms.
